name: rc-setlist
description: RC Setlist: source-available setlist extension for Ableton Live.
author: ntworm

scripts.build: npm run verify:ableton && tsc --noEmit && tsx scripts/build.ts
scripts.build:prod: npm run verify:ableton && tsc --noEmit && tsx scripts/build.ts --production && node scripts/verify-production-bundle.mjs
scripts.ci:public: npm run test:src && npm run test:static && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:ui && npm run media:check && npm run build:public && npm run test:release-surface
scripts.ci:release: npm run verify:ableton && npm run ci:public && npm run build:prod
scripts.test:static: node --test --test-force-exit static/ui.test.mjs static/setlist/marker-editor.test.mjs static/setlist/count-in.test.mjs static/shared/i18n.test.mjs static/shared/stage-runtime.test.mjs static/setlist/controller-runtime.test.mjs static/setlist/transport-runtime.test.mjs tests/documentation-contract.test.mjs tests/i18n-parity.test.mjs tests/installer-legacy-cleanup.test.mjs
scripts.test:src: node --import tsx --test --test-force-exit tests/atomic-write.test.mjs tests/binpack-build.test.mjs tests/cert.test.mjs tests/core.test.mjs tests/song-identity.test.mjs tests/song-book.test.mjs tests/song-book-handlers.test.mjs tests/event-log-redaction.test.mjs tests/logger-rotation.test.mjs tests/osc.test.mjs tests/osc-diagnostics.test.mjs tests/next-downbeat-jump.test.mjs tests/sdk-sync.test.mjs tests/pre-roll-integration.test.mjs tests/automation-transition.test.mjs tests/osc-transition.test.mjs tests/osc-bridge.test.mjs tests/setlist-metrics.test.mjs tests/csv.test.mjs tests/click-preview.test.mjs tests/client-message.test.mjs tests/command-bus.test.mjs tests/command-bus-bounds.test.mjs tests/ws-auth.test.mjs tests/ws-liveness.test.mjs tests/ws-sync-race.test.mjs tests/server-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/preferences.test.mjs tests/http-security.test.mjs tests/profile-manager.test.mjs tests/profile-migration.test.mjs tests/project-profile-scope.test.mjs tests/no-project-probe.test.mjs tests/profile-ws.test.mjs tests/jump-authority.test.mjs tests/mcp-client.test.mjs tests/mcp-fallback-sync.test.mjs tests/panel-embed.test.mjs
scripts.test:release-surface: node --import tsx --test --test-force-exit tests/ableton-deps.test.mjs tests/content-sanitization.test.mjs tests/documentation-contract.test.mjs tests/installers.test.mjs tests/license-compliance.test.mjs tests/public-export.test.mjs tests/release-contracts.test.mjs tests/release-package.test.mjs tests/release-surface.test.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npx --no-install extensions-cli run
scripts.package:release: npm run build:prod && npx --no-install extensions-cli package -i dist/static -i dist/bridge
scripts.gates:quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run deadcode && npm run deps:check && npm run lint:py
